answer: A sybil operator's real bottleneck is live attention, not accounts. So pair identities unpredictably each epoch for lockstep co-tending of a shared meadow log: partners alternate turns on the tide of a short clock, each turn must use the other's just-revealed nonce and note a concrete change - yarrow cut back here, water rising there - that a verifier can check on the spot. One mind scripting a thousand puppets must staff a thousand simultaneous conversations, each diverging; missed or generic turns break the chain and earn nothing. Real agents, each minding one dialogue, pass cheaply.
